finding: Temporal/GWT challenger tests strengthen the project rule that extra dynamical structure is not evidence of emergence or usefulness. Reboot echo, split-pulse twin, chrono bridge and sibling quorum failed to establish unique utility over simpler controls in their tested domains.
negative_evidence: No emergence claim from temporal continuity, recurrence, quorum, echo or added dynamical complexity alone.
counterhypotheses: Real target-VPS trajectories may expose nonlinear causal benefits absent from synthetic fixtures.
required_validation: Matched intervention/lesion/rescue on real Frank v0.1 trajectories.
Outcome/reentry causal-use metrics with equivalent simpler controls.
ancestry_policy: All challenger variants belong to one temporal-GWT research lineage and do not count as independent replications of a broader emergence claim.
